# mg37-windowsdx-pkgconfig

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license. The `.xnb` file is an ASCII placeholder, not compiled content.

## Purpose

An old MonoGame 3.7 Windows (DirectX) project in the NuGet era: installer imports, a `packages.config`, a direct SharpDX reference, a .NET Framework 4.7 target, an x86-only build and a prebuilt `.xnb` file. It is never built.

## Positive for

MG001, MG002, MG003, MG004, MG005, MG006, MG007, MG020, MG027.
